personalInfo.name: Roberto Abad Ramirez Nieves
personalInfo.title: Senior iOS Engineer
personalInfo.description: Senior iOS Engineer with 7+ years of experience building scalable, accessible, and high-performance mobile applications. Led feature development for the Wells Fargo iOS app serving millions of users, with deep expertise in SwiftUI, GraphQL, and modern iOS architecture.

paragraphs: I am a Senior iOS Engineer with over 7 years of professional experience delivering scalable mobile solutions across banking, enterprise, and consumer applications.
I specialize in Swift, SwiftUI, GraphQL, and accessibility-first development, with a strong track record modernizing legacy codebases and mentoring development teams.

highlights.title: Mobile Architecture
highlights.description: Expertise in SwiftUI, UIKit, Combine, MVVM-C, and enterprise-scale iOS architecture

highlights.title: Accessibility
highlights.description: Delivered inclusive and compliant UIs supporting VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, and external keyboards

highlights.title: Leadership
highlights.description: Mentored engineers, led migrations, and collaborated cross-functionally in Agile teams

experience.title: Senior iOS Engineer
experience.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
description: Led development of native features for the Wells Fargo iOS banking app serving millions of daily users
Migrated critical flows from legacy WebViews to Swift and SwiftUI, improving performance and UX
Introduced Apollo GraphQL CLI and modernized the network layer
Delivered accessible UIs meeting strict banking compliance standards
Collaborated with Android, QA, Backend, and Design teams in Agile Scrum environments

experience.title: iOS Developer Consultant
description: Completed an intensive iOS bootcamp focused on SwiftUI, Combine, and enterprise patterns
Trained in MVVM-C and VIPER architectures
Prepared for enterprise client deployment through mock banking applications

experience.title: Development Coordinator / Full Stack Developer
description: Oversaw end-to-end software projects and mentored junior developers
Led development of internal systems, databases, and server infrastructure

education.description: Focus on software engineering and systems development

testimonials.name: John Smith
testimonials.text: Roberto is an exceptional iOS engineer who consistently delivers high-quality work. His expertise in SwiftUI and GraphQL helped modernize our entire mobile architecture.

testimonials.name: Sarah Johnson
testimonials.text: Working with Roberto was a pleasure. His attention to accessibility and user experience made our banking app much more inclusive for all users.

testimonials.text: Roberto's leadership and technical skills were instrumental in delivering multiple successful projects. He's a natural mentor and excellent problem solver.
